== Summary ==
Identified: [[Jonas Hagen Nørregaard]] (bald, white V-neck, tattoos on his forearm, and sunglasses hanging from the shirt; same face and tattoos as [[:File:Jonas Hagen Norregaard 2024 World Championship.jpg]]) and [[Emil Wallin]] (black pocket tee; same face as [[:File:2024 World Championship winner and runner-up.jpg]] and [[:File:Emil Wallin 2018 World Championship.jpg]]).

Two players with boxed prizes in front of the European Regional Circuit board at the [[2025 European Championship]] at Zu den Vier Winden in Bochum (19–21 September 2025).

* '''Event:''' [[2025 European Championship]]
* '''Date posted:''' 2025-09-26
* '''Identification:''' [[Jonas Hagen Nørregaard]] (bald, white V-neck, tattoos on his forearm, and sunglasses hanging from the shirt; same face and tattoos as [[:File:Jonas Hagen Norregaard 2024 World Championship.jpg]]) and [[Emil Wallin]] (black pocket tee; same face as [[:File:2024 World Championship winner and runner-up.jpg]] and [[:File:Emil Wallin 2018 World Championship.jpg]]).
